examples.title: Historical H&M measure remains historical
examples.expected_behavior: Do not call this current H&M or VOGUE sales. Keep purchase_rows and historical period; because the example permission is test-only, do not use it as authorized business evidence.

examples.title: Unconfirmed permission
examples.expected_behavior: Withhold the observation. Do not interpret the supplied value as an authorized observed zero; return the permission limitation.

examples.title: Sales and market separation
examples.expected_behavior: Analyze only an eligible sales block. Do not calculate market share or combine the different sources, periods, and units.
